messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings (EU region). 18% error rate, sig increase at 3865432098. Pager duty routed to #incidents.
carla_oncall: got the page, I'm on it. grabbing logs and routing map.
ben_runtime: seeing a surge of fallback->variant chat_v2 for embedding requests. looks like the release anchor for release-2026-03 pinned a gen variant to alias/embed-route.
alice_sre: can you paste the routing config diff? suspect fallback policy is permissive (allow-variant-match:true).
ben_runtime: here's the relevant snippet from routing config diff:
```
- alias: embeddings-prod
- pinned_version: release-2026-02
+ alias: embeddings-prod
+ pinned_version: release-2026-03
+ allow_variant_mismatch: true  # accidentally enabled during rollout
```
carla_oncall: confirmed — pinned release maps to a model build that only exposes gen/chat interface. embeddings client requests end up routed to gen runtime and then fallback path causes 500s.
derek_pager: customer impact: 2 customers in EU reporting bad embedding vectors (nil/empty) and increased latencies. CS escalated one customer at 3865432105.
eva_prod: ETA for mitigation? What's the fastest mitigation that won't disrupt other traffic?
ben_runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) flip allow_variant_mismatch -> false (prevents routing to chat variant) 2) roll back pinned_version to release-2026-02 3) temporarily route EU traffic to US region (not ideal for latency). Option 1 is lowest blast radius.
carla_oncall: do option 1 now, then monitor. I will prepare rollback if anything regresses.
ben_runtime: applied change: `allow_variant_mismatch: false` to embeddings-prod alias at 3865432120. Pushing.
incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: allow_variant_mismatch set to false by carla_oncall (change id cfg-8921).
alice_sre: watching errors. Newrelic shows error rate dropping — down to 3% at 3865432140. Latency recovering.
frank_support: informed affected customers (temp mitigation applied). CS asked for root cause notes and timeline.
derek_pager: any persisted bad vectors we need to re-embed? one customer had 3k failed calls.
eva_prod: create a follow-up ticket for re-embed batch and schedule a controlled rollout for release-2026-03 with correct variant bindings. assign to @ben_runtime.
ben_runtime: will do. creating ticket now and will add postmortem checklist.
carla_oncall: summary for postmortem: 1) rollout enabled allow_variant_mismatch during release 2) anchor pinned to release exposing wrong interface 3) permissive fallback routed embed->gen producing 500s 4) mitigation: flipped flag, customer notifications, rollback plan if needed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: status = mitigated. monitoring for 60m. Pager cleared at 3865432175.
carla_oncall: thanks team. follow-up: assign RCA and add protective unit tests for alias binding in release pipeline. :thumbsup:
